projects.name: Odessa Facility
projects.quote: Our largest data center is the Odessa Facility which is our wholly-owned 207 MW facility located in Odessa, Texas.

projects.name: Alborz facility
projects.quote: We also operate our Alborz, Bear and Chief facilities in different sites across Texas pursuant to a joint venture with WindHQ where we have a 49% membership interest in each facility.

projects.name: Bear facility
projects.quote: We also operate our Alborz, Bear and Chief facilities in different sites across Texas pursuant to a joint venture with WindHQ where we have a 49% membership interest in each facility.

projects.name: Chief facility
projects.quote: We also operate our Alborz, Bear and Chief facilities in different sites across Texas pursuant to a joint venture with WindHQ where we have a 49% membership interest in each facility.

projects.name: Fifth data center (wholly-owned)
projects.quote: Our fifth data center, which is wholly-owned, is expected to commence operations in 2025.

projects.name: Black Pearl Facility
projects.quote: Management intends to continue with the infrastructure buildout at the Black Pearl Facility to get the site to full capacity in support of our current business plans.

projects.name: Luminant Power Agreement
projects.quote: Cost of revenue for the year ended December 31, 2023 was $50.3 million, compared with $0.7 million for the year ended December 31, 2022, and consisted primarily of power costs at the Odessa Facility under the Luminant Power Agreement, which began operations in November, 2022.

projects.name: Luminant Lease Agreement
projects.quote: On August 23, 2023, the Company entered into a second amendment of the Luminant Lease Agreement, the terms of which included confirming the initial term will end on July 31, 2027.

projects.name: Bitmain miner purchase commitments
projects.quote: We currently have purchase commitments for miners of $98.8 million primarily related to the Black Pearl Facility that will require resources beyond our existing financial resources as of December 31, 2023.
